name: Macify Product Interface

components.publicHeader: Three-column brand, centered navigation, command search and dashboard link.
components.macShelf: One large editorial feature beside a compact Finder-like application index.
components.applicationRow: App icon, identity, one-line task description, category, pricing and destination affordance.
components.collectionBand: Deep aubergine editorial feature with restrained honey label and white secondary action.
components.dashboardSidebar: Fixed-width white navigation rail with a honey selected state.
components.statusStrip: Four contiguous factual cells inside one bordered panel.
components.dataTable: Compact editorial record table with internal responsive horizontal overflow.

constraints: Use OKLCH for every authored color.
Use one filled primary action per local action group.
Reserve pills for categories, status and compact filters.
Meet WCAG 2.2 AA for core workflows.
Let application media supply most of the page color.
